messages.subject: Problem in GWS 5.0 CNV Detection

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem in GWS 5.0 CNV Detection
parts:
Hi,

the fragment-length annotation data from Affymetrix was more or less
broken for GWS 5.0, which *might* explain your problem. Affymetrix
recently updated this data (from NetAffx) and I am in the process you
upgrading the UFL (and UGP) files, which *might* solve you problem. I
will let you know when I've done that and then I hope that solves your
problem.

If you want to process, you can skip the fragment-length normalization
step and continue to the segmentation (if that is what you are doing).
Fragment-length normalization will only boost the signal-to-noise a
bit, but you without it you should at least find the big regions.

/Henrik

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem in GWS 5.0 CNV Detection
parts:
Hi,

there was related problems for GWS6, which have been fixed in the
latest patches. Please install those patches;

library(aroma.affymetrix);
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix");

and retry. Let us know if it helps.

Note that I still haven't updated the UFL files to reflect the latest
NetAffx updates, but at least you shouldn't get an error (I hope).

/Henrik
